title: Builder: the four variants the builder names that the roles lack (Hero glow and minimal, Gatherings agenda, Figures bar)
detail:
Adds hero variants glow and minimal, gatherings variant agenda (week ribbon plus rows), stats variant bar. Existing variants and stored pages are untouched; presentation defaults stay as they are until BLD-212. Done when: the three role JSON files list the variants, each renders with its sample and an empty state, and a page stored before this change renders identically. PROGRESS (2026-11-03, with BLD-210): hero glow and minimal, stats bar and chapters timetable are built. Still open: gatherings agenda (week ribbon plus rows), which needs the date logic.

Gatherings agenda built: a ribbon of the dates on offer above ruled rows. Rendered on three themes at 390 and 1440 and across all ten at five widths with no overflow.
